description: This Java class handles the processing of a create teller command within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, uses annotations for command type and dependency injection, and delegates the creation logic to the TellerWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateTellerCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles create commands for tellers, delegating creation logic to the teller write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to create a teller by delegating to the write platform service.
